convertibility_reason: Uses only custom SMA calculation on median price (no external indicators or iCustom calls), simple entry/exit rules based on AO direction change, fixed or percentage-based position sizing, no external .mqh libraries for trading logic (Trade.mqh is standard), no grid/martingale/pending order complexity.

derived_values.name: AO array values (5 elements)
derived_values.formula: SMA(median, Period_sma_slow, i) - SMA(median, Period_sma_fast, i)

other_exits: Opposite signal closes all opposite-side positions: when AO[0]<AO[1] all sells are closed; when AO[0]>AO[1] all buys are closed

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If LotFromPercent>0 then lot = MathFloor(FreeMargin*LotFromPercent/ContractSize/LotStep)*LotStep, clamped to [Lot_min, Lot_max]; otherwise use LotFixed=0.01, also clamped to [Lot_min, Lot_max]

custom_logic_notes: The EA stacks positions up to 'Orders' (default 10) per side. AO is calculated manually as SMA5(median) - SMA34(median) on the current bar index 0 and 1. Entry condition AO[0]<AO[1] means AO is declining (not a zero-line crossover, but a momentum-direction change between the two most recent bars). Close logic: when AO direction reverses, ALL opposite-side positions are closed via while-loop iteration. There is a bug on line 132: margin check for SELL uses ORDER_TYPE_BUY instead of ORDER_TYPE_SELL. No SL/TP are set on any trade (both passed as 0). The 'bars' variable controls how much history to copy: Period_sma_fast+Period_sma_slow=39, but only 5 elements of AO are computed and only the first 2 are used.
python_conversion_notes: The AO calculation is straightforward: compute median price as (H+L)/2, then SMA5 and SMA34 on that median, then AO = SMA5 - SMA34. Entry when AO declines (AO[0]<AO[1]) -> buy; when AO rises (AO[0]>AO[1]) -> sell. Signal reversal closes all opposite positions. No built-in indicator handles needed - all calculated from OHLC data. Position stacking up to max_positions per side. Margin check function should be adapted to broker API equivalents. Note the ORDER_TYPE_BUY bug on the sell margin check line should be fixed in conversion (use SELL type). Normalize price to tick size before placing orders.
